limits: All rebuilt archive hashes differ from their original frozen hashes and are versioned replacement execution inputs.

Python installed metadata and root Node package versions describe the rebuilt cache at inspection time. Original resolved versions remain unknown wherever saved original evidence does not establish them.
Unchanged lower-bound or range recipes can resolve different versions. Neither recipe equality nor similar archive size proves dependency equivalence.
Node versions cover root node_modules only. Per-file package or distribution metadata hashes identify inspected metadata; replacement archive hashes identify the complete cached contents.
No claim is made that focused offline smoke coverage replaces full tests, live PostgreSQL checks, or paid reviewer calibration.
